hook_candidates.headline: You lose two hours weekly on receipts.

caption:
You spend hours copying receipts into spreadsheets. That stops now. Google Search added Personal Intelligence on November 23, 2026. It reads your financial data directly.

Go to your Search Personalization settings webpage. Toggle the feature on. It currently pulls data from Google Wallet. You keep full control and can disconnect it anytime. It identifies spending habits and optimizes credit card rewards.

body.t: Personal Intelligence means Google Search reads your Google Wallet payment app and Drive files.
Personal Intelligence eliminates manual expense tracking by reading your spending data, like lunch.
Personal Intelligence rolls out now for Google Wallet users while Drive support arrives later.
